title: Purair® NANO Ductless Nanoparticle Containment Enclosures
meta_title: Purair NANO Ductless Nanoparticle Enclosures - Protect Operators from Nanomaterials
meta_description: The Purair NANO ductless nanoparticle containment enclosures protect operators from nanomaterial particles under 100nm encountered during processing of carbon nanotubes, lithium batteries, and rare earth metals.
meta_keywords: purair nano, ductless nanoparticle enclosures, nanoparticle containment, carbon nanotubes, lithium batteries, rare earth metals
short_description: Protects the operator from nanomaterial particles (less than 100nm in size) encountered during processing of carbon nanotubes, lithium batteries, and rare earth metals.
full_description: Using innovative filtration technology, the Purair NANO creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the industry. Protects the operator from nanomaterial particles (less than 100nm in size) encountered during processing of carbon nanotubes, lithium batteries, and rare earth metals. SafeSwitch™ Filter Shutter System (optional) for safer bag-out filter exchange. Improved filter clamping eliminates bypass leakage. Filter blockage alarm. High efficiency ebm-papst EC blower. Energy saving LED lighting.
seo_content: The Purair NANO ductless nanoparticle enclosures are designed to provide a safe work environment for a wide range of applications involving nanomaterials, including carbon nanotubes, lithium battery processing, and rare earth metal handling. These advanced containment systems utilize innovative filtration technology to protect operators from exposure to particles less than 100 nanometers in size. Key features include the optional SafeSwitch™ Filter Shutter System for safer filter exchange, improved filter clamping to eliminate bypass leakage, and a filter blockage alarm to ensure optimal performance. Powered by a high-efficiency EC blower and featuring energy-saving LED lighting, the Purair NANO enclosures deliver comprehensive protection and operational efficiency.

Construction & Compliance.OSHA Compliance: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood. Please consult your Safety Officer and/or Industrial Hygienist.
